Whoever captures one legitimate webhook request (proxy logs, the plaintext custom header on a non-TLS self-hosted deployment) can replay it indefinitely, and any operator of any child instance holding the shared secret can write credentials into any other instance/user reachable with the same secret. There is no per-request binding, no replay window, and no way to rotate without coordinating every deployment.
